summary: A Quote subscription: the 67-byte QUOTE packet becomes a Quote frame with the trade time in epoch ms, under both last-quantity names; the packet's change and 52-week range are not carried yet.

deviations.reason: The web passes Paytm's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.

The desktop sends the canonical last_quantity beside last_trade_quantity in Quote; the Paytm web adapter's Quote frame names it last_trade_quantity only (paytm_adapter.py:715). Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent on an instrument beside the web adapter's own change keys (change_absolute, change_percent); the adapter sends no price_change, which is not a docs key, so it goes.
